stem_book: State whether the following are true or false. (i) The equilibrium state can only be achieved in a closed system. (ii) The equilibrium constant for a reaction is dependent on the concentration of the reactants and products. (iii) In an equilibrium mixture, the concentration of reactants is always equal to the concentration of products. (iv) Kc is the equilibrium constant in terms of molarity, while Kp is the equilibrium constant in terms of pressure. (v) The law of mass action is another name for the law of chemical equilibrium. (vi) A change in temperature changes the value of the equilibrium constant. (vii) Addition of a catalyst changes the position of the equilibrium.
